variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 3:20 reads 'My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is bowed down within me' — an intransitive bowing of the soul itself, which is the qere we-tashoach (Qal of shuach, 'and is bowed down'). The ketiv wa-tasiach would give either 'and muses/meditates' (siach) or a causative 'bows [it] down'; the ASV renders neither, so its wording selects the qere.
